items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1969-12-30
items.q: That was the original Blue Devils. And he had Orrin, Kid Lips Page, that was in the same band.

ctx.x: I know you tell me about meeting many different people. What about Walter Page?

Now, which one? You have more than one Walter Page. I'm talking about the bass player. Oh, the bass player. That was the original Blue Devils. And he had Orrin, Kid Lips Page, that was in the same band. And also Count Basin.
Did you ever meet up with them?
